Some patients report congestive heart failure while taking this medicine.
A possible treatment-related effect includes intensification of AV block.
Monitoring is advised because hypotension may occur.
Some patients report paresthesia of hands while taking this medicine.
Some patients report thrombocytopenic purpura while taking this medicine.
Monitoring is advised because arterial insufficiency, usually of the Raynaud type may occur.

faqs.question: Can I rely on this Propranolol hydrochloride information instead of a doctor visit?
faqs.answer: No. This content supports learning and preparation for conversations with qualified healthcare professionals. It is not a substitute for diagnosis or treatment.

faqs.question: Can I adjust the dose of Propranolol hydrochloride on my own?
faqs.answer: Dose changes should only be made with clinician guidance. Self-adjustment can increase side effects or reduce effectiveness.
